title: Crash Loop
story: The payments container keeps crashing, and its restart policy keeps launching it again. Every restart pages the on-call engineer. The api container is unaffected.
objective: Stop the crash-looping payments container without removing it, keep api running, and finish by displaying payments' logs so the fault is on screen for the incident channel.
hints: A restarting status and a climbing RestartCount in docker inspect mean a restart policy keeps relaunching a failing process.
Docker does not restart a container you stopped yourself, even when it has an on-failure restart policy.
Run docker stop payments, then docker logs payments.
explanation: A restart policy relaunches a container whose process exits with an error. When the error is permanent, such as a missing secret, the policy produces a crash loop. docker stop ends the loop and keeps the container, and its logs show the same fatal line once per attempt.
